title: Can Rabbits Eat Gooseberries?
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Can Rabbits Eat Gooseberries?
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage and rabbit food guides.
-->

<section class="rcg-page alignfull" id="can-rabbits-eat-gooseberries">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-radius-lg: 24px;
      --rc-radius-md: 16px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rcg-page,
    .rcg-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rcg-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rcg-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

    .rcg-page a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rcg-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rcg-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rcg-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rcg-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rcg-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rcg-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcg-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .rcg-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rcg-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcg-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rcg-hero-image-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcg-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rcg-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcg-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rcgFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rcg-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 720px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rcg-hero-title-overlay .rcg-pill {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcg-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rcg-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rcg-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rcg-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcg-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rcg-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcg-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rcg-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcg-hero-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rcg-hero-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcg-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcg-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcg-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }

    .rcg-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcg-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcg-quick:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14);
    }

    .rcg-quick-icon {
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .rcg-quick strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rcg-quick span span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rcg-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }

    .rcg-section-header {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rcg-section h2,
    .rcg-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcg-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rcg-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rcg-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rcg-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcg-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcg-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rcg-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }

    .rcg-panel h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcg-panel p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.03rem;
    }

    .rcg-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rcg-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 22px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcg-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcg-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcg-treat-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcg-treat-card {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcg-treat-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rcg-treat-card b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .rcg-treat-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.22rem; }
    .rcg-treat-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcg-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcg-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rcg-warning-card h2 { color: var(--rc-danger); }

    .rcg-warning-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
    }

    .rcg-warning-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcg-warning-list li {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcg-warning-list strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-danger);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rcg-image-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .rcg-image-card { position: relative; min-height: 430px; }

    .rcg-image-card img {
      position: absolute;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
    }

    .rcg-image-card img:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important; }

    .rcg-img-main {
      width: 78%;
      height: 340px;
      left: 0;
      top: 20px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .rcg-img-small {
      width: 52%;
      height: 230px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 34px;
      transform: rotate(4deg);
      object-fit: contain !important;
      background: #fff9ef;
    }

    .rcg-prep {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcg-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcg-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcg-step b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rcg-step h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }
    .rcg-step p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcg-sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 22px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .rcg-side-card {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcg-side-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rcg-side-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcg-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcg-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rcg-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcg-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    .rcg-benefits-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rcg-benefit {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcg-benefit h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.15rem; }
    .rcg-benefit p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcg-final { padding: 70px 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }

    .rcg-final-box {
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border-radius: 46px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)),
        url("https://rabbitcare.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-gooseberry.png");
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcg-final-box .rcg-pill,
    .rcg-final-box h2,
    .rcg-final-box p {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rcg-final-box p {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
    }

    .rcg-final-box .rcg-btn-secondary {
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #2f4a2e;
      border: 2px solid #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      text-shadow: none;
    }

    .rcg-related {
      padding: 74px 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
      animation: none !important;
    }

    .rcg-related,
    .rcg-related * {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      filter: none !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rcg-related .rcg-section-header {
      padding: 30px;
      border-radius: 34px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.14);
    }

    .rcg-related .rcg-section-header .rcg-pill { color: #4e6b45 !important; }

    .rcg-related .rcg-section-header h2 {
      color: #243320 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rcg-related .rcg-section-header p {
      color: #332d26 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .rcg-related-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcg-related-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr;
      gap: 15px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff !important;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
      transition: transform 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease;
    }

    .rcg-related-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); background: #fff; }

    .rcg-related-card img {
      width: 92px;
      height: 92px;

            <span class="rcg-pill">Rabbit food guide</span>
            <h2>Gooseberries are a classic British fruit, but very tart for rabbits</h2>
            <p>
              Gooseberries are a well-known British garden fruit, and rabbit owners with access to a gooseberry bush often wonder whether they are safe to share. The good news is that ripe fresh gooseberries are not toxic to rabbits and can be offered in very small amounts as an occasional treat.
            </p>
            <p>
              However, gooseberries are significantly more tart and acidic than many other fruits, and unripe gooseberries can be especially sharp. They should only ever be offered very occasionally and should never replace hay, fresh water or leafy greens in a rabbit's daily diet.
            </p>
          </section>

          <section class="rcg-panel" id="safe">
            <span class="rcg-pill">Safe in very small amounts</span>
            <h2>Are gooseberries safe for rabbits?</h2>
            <p>
              Yes, ripe fresh gooseberries are safe for most healthy adult rabbits when offered in very small amounts. The flesh and skin can both be eaten, though the tartness may put some rabbits off entirely.
            </p>
            <p>
              Always use ripe gooseberries rather than unripe ones, as unripe gooseberries are far more acidic and could cause more digestive discomfort. A healthy rabbit diet should consist mostly of hay, which supports digestion and keeps teeth worn down naturally. Hay should make up around 80–90% of what a rabbit eats every day.
            </p>
          </section>

          <h2>How many gooseberries can rabbits eat?</h2>
          <p>
            Gooseberries should only be offered in very small amounts. One gooseberry at a time is a sensible maximum for most rabbits, and even this should be offered no more than once a week.
          </p>
          <p>
            Because gooseberries are so tart, many rabbits will show little interest in them. If your rabbit ignores the gooseberry completely, there is no need to push it. There are plenty of other rabbit-safe treats they may enjoy more.
          </p>

          <ul class="rcg-list">
            <li>Offer just one ripe gooseberry at a time.</li>
            <li>Feed gooseberries no more than once a week at most.</li>
            <li>Only use ripe gooseberries, avoid unripe, very hard, or very sour ones.</li>
            <li>Introduce slowly and watch for any changes in poo, appetite or behaviour.</li>
          </ul>

          <p>
            The acidity of gooseberries, especially unripe ones, makes it especially important to keep portions very small and to only ever use ripe, fresh berries. Never feed cooked or preserved gooseberry products.
          </p>

        <ul class="rcg-warning-list">
          <li>
            <strong>Never feed unripe gooseberries</strong>
            Unripe gooseberries are far more acidic and much harder on a rabbit's sensitive digestive system. Only offer fully ripe, soft berries.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Watch for digestive upset</strong>
            Too many gooseberries can cause soft stools or a change in digestion. If this happens, remove the fruit and return to hay and leafy greens.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>No cooked or preserved gooseberries</strong>
            Do not feed gooseberry jam, gooseberry fool, cooked gooseberries, tinned gooseberries, or any product containing gooseberries and added sugar.

          <article class="rcg-step">
            <b>2</b>
            <h3>Top and tail</h3>
            <p>Remove the small stem end and the dried flower end (the top and tail) before feeding, as these are tough and fibrous.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcg-step">
            <b>3</b>
            <h3>Wash thoroughly</h3>
            <p>Rinse the gooseberry under cold water to remove any garden residue, dirt or pesticide traces from the skin.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcg-step">
            <b>4</b>
            <h3>Feed very occasionally</h3>
            <p>Offer just one gooseberry at a time, no more than once a week, and only during the fresh summer season.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcg-section rcg-reveal" id="benefits">
      <div class="rcg-wrap">
        <div class="rcg-section-header">
          <span class="rcg-pill">Treat benefits</span>
          <h2>Benefits and signs your rabbit enjoys gooseberries</h2>
          <p>
            When offered in very small amounts, a ripe gooseberry can add seasonal variety. Many rabbits will be indifferent, and that is absolutely fine.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcg-benefits-grid">
          <article class="rcg-benefit">
            <h3>Seasonal variety</h3>
            <p>A gooseberry can add a small seasonal novelty during the summer months when they are naturally in season.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcg-benefit">
            <h3>Small amounts of nutrients</h3>
            <p>Gooseberries contain vitamins C and A, though they should not replace leafy greens or hay as nutrient sources.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcg-benefit">
            <h3>Easy to portion</h3>
            <p>Their individual size makes gooseberries straightforward to portion, one is genuinely one serving.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcg-benefit">
            <h3>Garden enrichment</h3>
            <p>For garden rabbits or those with outdoor time, sniffing and tasting a seasonal fruit can be mildly enriching.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcg-benefit">
            <h3>Signs they enjoy it</h3>
            <p>Your rabbit may sniff cautiously and then nibble, or chew and look for more. Many will simply ignore it, both responses are normal.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcg-benefit">
            <h3>Still keep treats rare</h3>
            <p>Even a rabbit that enjoys gooseberries should only have them very occasionally to keep their diet properly balanced.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <section class="rcg-section rcg-reveal" id="faq">
      <div class="rcg-narrow">
        <div class="rcg-section-header">
          <span class="rcg-pill">Frequently asked questions</span>
          <h2>Gooseberry FAQs</h2>
          <p>Quick answers to common questions about feeding gooseberries to rabbits.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcg-faq-grid">
          <details class="rcg-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat gooseberries?</summary>
            <p>Yes, rabbits can eat ripe fresh gooseberries in very small amounts. They should be a rare treat because they are tart, acidic and contain natural sugars.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="rcg-faq-item">
            <summary>Are gooseberries safe for rabbits?</summary>
            <p>Ripe fresh gooseberries are safe for most healthy adult rabbits when offered sparingly. Avoid unripe gooseberries because they are much sharper and more acidic.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="rcg-faq-item">
            <summary>How many gooseberries can rabbits eat?</summary>
            <p>One ripe gooseberry at a time is enough for most rabbits, and it should be offered no more than once a week. Many rabbits may not like the sharp taste.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="rcg-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat unripe gooseberries?</summary>
            <p>No. Unripe gooseberries are much more acidic and may upset a rabbit's sensitive digestion. Only offer fully ripe, soft gooseberries.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="rcg-faq-item">
            <summary>Do you need to top and tail gooseberries for rabbits?</summary>
            <p>Yes. Remove the small stem end and dried flower end before feeding, then wash the gooseberry well and offer only a tiny amount.</p>
          </details>
          <details class="rcg-faq-item">
            <summary>Can rabbits eat cooked gooseberries or gooseberry jam?</summary>
            <p>No. Rabbits should not eat cooked gooseberries, gooseberry jam, tinned gooseberries, gooseberry fool or any preserved gooseberry product with added sugar.</p>
          </details>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rcg-final rcg-reveal">
      <div class="rcg-wrap rcg-final-box">
        <span class="rcg-pill">Final thoughts</span>
        <h2>Gooseberries can be a safe but very rare rabbit treat</h2>
        <p>
          Rabbits can eat ripe fresh gooseberries in very small amounts, and the occasional berry during summer season is unlikely to cause harm. However, gooseberries are one of the more acidic fruits you might consider offering, so portion size and ripeness really do matter.
        </p>
        <p>
          Always top and tail the berry, use only ripe fruit, and keep the portion to one gooseberry at most. Never feed cooked or preserved gooseberry products. As always, a rabbit's diet should be based primarily on hay, with leafy greens and vegetables making up the rest of their daily food.
        </p>
